name: 1001sovet.ru fail-closed production certification
principles: Public production probes are read-only and earn PASS only from a named live service response.
Mocks, fixtures, local emulators, dry-runs and simulated provider callbacks never certify a production journey.
Missing QA identity, provider sandbox, cleanup authority or proof is BLOCKED, never silently skipped.
State-changing tests require dedicated owned resources and an explicit E2E_ALLOW_ACTIVE=1 approval.
